engine.label: Kokoro v1.0 MLX bf16 · am_michael
engine.streaming: segment waveforms: speak-easy planSegments + trimSilence port, one generate call, newline separated segments; not incremental within a segment
engine.chunkPolicy: first chunk: first clause or 4 words of sentence 1, then whole sentences; each chunk trimmed, 150 ms gap appended
engine.cancellation: between segments (host stops pulling the generator); an active segment's MLX inference is not preempted

loadDetail.note: loadMs is mlx_audio load_model on the local snapshot plus the misaki G2P pipeline; mlx-audio reloads the voice pack inside every generate call

chunks.text: The migration ran overnight and finished without errors, so the new tables are live in staging.
I checked the dashboards this morning, and response times are back under two hundred milliseconds.
The export button still times out on very large projects, and one of the email templates shows the old logo.
I have opened tickets for both and assigned them to Maya, who expects to close them by Thursday.
If you are happy with that plan, I will schedule the production rollout for Friday morning, before the team meeting.
Let me know if you would rather wait until next week, and I will move everything back.
